lines.en: I walk over originium shards.
Black crystal knots my fur.
I crush forward, step after step.
My weight collapses the snow.
I am slow, but you will not escape.
The crystals on my back click.
I walk toward your warm breath.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上划出沟
lines.en: My claws carve furrows.
I never go around anything.

lines.zh: 我每走一步就多一分躁
lines.en: Each step makes me wilder.
The originium on me glows.
I break the trees in my way.
I pant heavily with my head low.
The crystals grow slowly.
I am listening to my own blood.
My head is not very clear.
My breath carries dust.
I tremble even standing.
Black veins run through my eyes.
I am holding something back.
The originium weighs me down.
I tore a strip of bark off.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在冷气里结成白雾
lines.en: Your breath turns to white mist in the cold
You are dusted with originium.

lines.zh: 我把前爪搭在冰上，等你动
lines.en: I plant a forepaw on the ice and wait for you to move
My eyes are not right.

lines.zh: 你退到雪堆后面，我也看得见
lines.en: Behind the snowbank, and I can still see you
Can you hear me pant?

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，闻你有没有恶意
lines.en: I lift my nose and smell whether you mean harm
My teeth are harder than your armor.
When I lift my head, the crystals rattle.
You smell of medicine.
I let out a roar.
My breathing thickens and my eyes go dark
That only made me wilder.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶簇碎了一颗
lines.en: A crystal on me shattered.
See, my blood is black.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把雪抖下来
lines.en: I shake my head and throw off the snow
I give up no ground.
Dust is rising from the wound.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下自己的胸口
lines.en: I claw at my own chest.
Hit me again and I lose control.
That is not food to me.
Originium is better than food.
Put that thing down.

lines.zh: 我闻不出食物的味道了
lines.en: I can no longer smell food.
I want stone.
Food makes me sick.
Take it away; the smell is too faint
That will draw others.
Do not try to feed me this.
Only originium will do for me.
You hit my crystals.

lines.zh: 你撞得我背上的晶响了一声
lines.en: You knocked a chime out of the crystals on my back
You are dusted now.
I did not give up a single step.
That must hurt your hand.
My hide is like stone.
Neither of us gave way.
I shoved you aside.
Do not come near my back.
The crystals will cut you.
My head is full of static.
Originium does not care for such things.
Everything on me is hardening.
You ask something strange.

lines.zh: 这阵躁劲一上来，我谁都不认
lines.en: When the frenzy rises, I know no one
Do not come any nearer to me.
I hurt too much to think of it.
Ask a physician about that.

lines.zh: 我这样靠近你，会伤到你
lines.en: Coming near you like this will hurt you
I only want some quiet.
I nudge it with a claw.
I scratched it open.
It is dusted with originium now.
Do not pick it up; it is foul.
My claws cannot pick it up.
I carry it to you in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，又吐了出来
lines.en: I bite down once, then spit it out
You had better not touch it.
This is dusted with originium.
I cannot see the ground clearly.
You. Stand still.

lines.zh: 你身上那股热气跑不掉
lines.en: That heat off you isn't getting away

lines.zh: 你胸腔的动静我听得见
lines.en: I hear the movement in your chest.
The originium urges me.
Do not run; it will be quicker.
I am heading your way.
I cannot tell who you are.
There is hostility on you.
My breathing is getting heavier.
These few steps will be quick.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里的粉开始烧了
lines.en: The dust in my nose is starting to burn
I have settled on you.

lines.zh: 我把雪刨开，露出底下的土
lines.en: I claw the snow away to bare the earth
There is rock wall behind you.
I cannot even stop myself.
Then let us get to it.
I follow your scent.
You are at the camp's edge.
I smash the fence aside.
My steps grow heavier.
You run slowly in the snow.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在雪里太深了
lines.en: Your tracks sink too deep in the snow
I circled once around you.
The crystals on my back shine brighter.
Running further is pointless.

lines.zh: 我这一步跨过去就是两格
lines.en: One stride of mine covers two blocks
The slope ahead is steep.
Look back once.
I am two blocks behind.
You are limping on your left leg.
The longer you run, the more frantic I get
This snowfield has no end.
Your sweat smells different now.
My claws sink into the snow.
I have begun to run.

lines.zh: 雪在我脚下碎成一片一片
lines.en: The snow breaks to pieces under my feet
I bring my paw down.

lines.zh: 这一下的力气不是我自己的
lines.en: This strength is not my own.
You are driven into the snow.
My claws carry crystal.
Your armor is torn open.
I roar, and the snow shakes.
You are thrown far back.
I could not hold back.

lines.zh: 这一掌下去，冰面都裂了
lines.en: One blow and the ice itself splits
I cannot see clearly when I strike.
The smell of your blood unsteadies me more.
Take one more from me.
I tore off your shoulder plate.
My paw swept you off your feet.

lines.zh: 这一击震得我晶簇发麻
lines.en: The blow left my crystals numb.
Do not let me grab you twice.
My claws are stuck in the ice.
You had better run faster.
I tear loose a chunk of snow.
You are pinned under me.
A mound swells in the snow.
I rise, taller than you.
Originium grows on me.
My eyes opened black.
I smelled people.
This snow was quiet before.

lines.zh: 我抖动身体，雪和粉齐落
lines.en: I shake; snow and dust fall.
My claws sink deep.
I walk toward the nearest living thing.
I cannot control myself.
You should be running now.
Crystals push through my back.
Fire crackles in my crystals.
I fell into a deep crater.
Icy water makes the originium ache.
The blast tore open my back.
The arrow sank only shallow.
The spell churns inside me.
Hunger leaves me nothing but frenzy.
Lightning runs through my crystals.

lines.zh: 这里没有源石，也没有雪
lines.en: No originium here, and no snow.
